id.description: Persistent entity ID within the Dataset; use it for detail lookup.

state.description: Campaign approval state: Proposed, Approved, or Archived. Approved does not necessarily mean actively serving.

status.description: Current serving status: Active, Inactive, ScheduleCompleted, or BudgetReached. Distinct from approval state.

advertiserId.description: Associated Advertiser ID; use the advertiser detail operation to inspect it.

budget.description: Campaign budget, discriminated by type (currently cpm), with an optional spending cap. CPM and spending cap use the same monetary unit.

startsAt.description: Inclusive campaign start timestamp with UTC offset; null means no start boundary.

endsAt.description: Inclusive campaign end timestamp with UTC offset; null means no end boundary.

created.description: Time the entity was created, with UTC offset.

modified.description: Time the entity was last modified, with UTC offset.

promotionsJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise promotion collection, including sponsored-product and display-ad promotions, their locations, and nested filters. Parse this string as JSON and preserve SDK $type metadata. Serialized from the SDK promotions configuration; null means no collection is provided, while an empty collection contains no promotions. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/retailmedia/campaigns.html and https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/index.html.

conditionsJson.description: JSON-encoded Relewise campaign conditions, including language-specific search-term conditions. Parse this string as JSON and preserve SDK $type metadata. Serialized from the SDK conditions configuration; null means no campaign-level conditions are configured. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/retailmedia/campaigns.html#promoting-by-specific-search-terms and https://docs.relewise.com/docs/filters/index.html.
